indicesNarrative: The tape is trading strictly as a derivative of the bond market today. With the US 10-year Treasury yield pushing above 5.14% and the 30-year touching 5.44%, high-multiple growth equities and tech leaders are facing valuation multiple compression. QQQ leads the downside while DIA shows relative defensive durability.
technicalsNarrative: SPY and QQQ have pulled back toward their 21-day EMAs with MACD histograms slipping negative, signaling a momentum cooling cycle. DIA is currently holding closest to support (AT-MA), offering cleaner risk-defined structural levels, whereas chasing extended tech names in QQQ presents heightened drawdown vulnerability until yields stabilize.
